We need to generate dataset of nitrides polymorphs. Need to retrieve compositions of nitrides. Not given list. Could generate list of nitrides up to some limit. Use batch_retrieve_polymorphs with compositions list. Need max_energy_above_hull 0.3, max_per_composition 3, max_compositions 40. So we need up to 40 compositions. Need list of nitride formulas. Could maybe use known nitrides: TiN, VN, CrN, MoN, ZrN, HfN, NbN, TaN, AlN, GaN, InN, Si3N4, BN, Mg3N2, Ca3N2, Sr3N2, Ba3N2, Li3N, Na3N, K3N, ScN, YN, LaN, CeN, PrN, NdN, SmN, EuN, GdN, TbN, DyN, HoN, ErN, TmN, YbN, LuN, FeN, CoN, NiN, CuN, ZnN, AgN, AuN, PtN, PdN. That's many.

We need to retrieve polymorphs for these compositions using batch_retrieve_polymorphs. Then consolidate into one dataset. Then prepare tabular dataset with advanced feature engineering, test split 0.2, normalize True. Then train XGBoost with given hyperparameters. Then evaluate and cross-validate. Finally save JSON results.

We need to use tools: batch_retrieve_polymorphs, consolidate_polymorph_datasets, prepare_tabular_dataset, train_xgboost_model, evaluate_xgboost_model, perform_cross_validation, write_file.

We need to know paths. Working directory: /Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_3

We'll create a subdirectory e.g., "polymorphs". Use batch_retrieve_polymorphs with compositions list, max_energy_above_hull 0.3, max_per_composition 3, save_directory that path.
